data.title: Miraaj
data.summary: ReelForge AI (Miraaj) is a functional prototype for planning and editing vertical videos, with AI-assisted script and scene planning.
data.approach: A project and dashboard workflow connects AI-assisted script and scene planning with a vertical-video editor.
data.implementation: The Next.js application supports scene and layer editing with undo/redo, uses Supabase for persistence and authentication, and includes Remotion-related rendering infrastructure. The video-generation pipeline works (owner-confirmed).
data.limitations: This is a development-stage prototype. Production deployment has not been verified.

data.title: Forecast-Buster
data.summary: Forecast-Guard AI, associated with Problem Statement 26079, is a functional prototype for exploring weather forecast bust risk across an interactive India grid.
data.problem: Estimate the risk of a weather forecast bust over a forecast horizon.
data.approach: The prototype includes spatial feature engineering, XGBoost training, isotonic calibration, nearest-neighbour analog code, and SHAP-related explanation code.
data.implementation: The system pairs a React/Vite dashboard with a Python/FastAPI service and uses local JSON, CSV, and joblib artifacts.
data.solution: The dashboard presents forecast bust risk spatially so a visitor can select a day or hazard and inspect risk summaries and cell-level information. Static mode does not provide the full live cell-drilldown experience.
data.limitations: Live Open-Meteo fetching and real observed historical training data were not verified. Reported metrics are not confirmed as real-world evaluation; the training pipeline may contain feature/data leakage. Explanations are static rather than computed SHAP values, and the sync button’s backend behavior is unverified. Production deployment, database, and authentication were not verified.
